body.name: Complete affine evaluation list
body.construction: \(\ell_1=-1+\alpha_1+\beta_1\), \(\ell_2=-1+\alpha_1+\beta_0\), \(\ell_3=-1+\alpha_0+\beta_0\), \(\ell_4=-1+\alpha_0+\beta_1\), \(\ell_5=-2+2\alpha_0+\gamma_1+\beta_0+\beta_1\), \(\ell_6=-2+\alpha_0+\alpha_1+\delta_0+2\beta_1\), \(\ell_7=-2+2\alpha_1+\gamma_0+\beta_0+\beta_1\), \(\ell_8=-2+\alpha_0+\alpha_1+\delta_1+2\beta_0\); then \(\mathfrak F^-_T=\{\ell_1,\ldots,\ell_8\}\cup\{\kappa-h_{cy}:c\in T\setminus\{a,b\},y\in\{0,1\}\}\) and \(\mathfrak F^+_T\) is its outcome-reversed negative.
